title: RubricHub: A Comprehensive and Highly Discriminative Rubric Dataset via Automated Coarse-to-Fine Generation
authors_zh: Sunzhu Li, Jiale Zhao, Huimin Ren, Zhenlin Wei, Yang Zhou, Jingwen Yang, Shunyu Liu, Kaike Zhang, Wei Chen
paper_type_zh: 自动粗到细评分准则生成与跨域奖励数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要为开放式生成构造细粒度、带权重的评分准则，并进行拒绝采样微调或基于准则强化学习的研究者。
one_line: RubricHub releases roughly 110K cross-domain, weighted rubric evaluations for fine-tuning and rubric-based RL on open-ended generation.
约 11 万跨域 rubric/评分样本，含 criterion、权重、评分和评审细节，可供 RM 微调与 RL。
why: It preserves the criterion, weight, score, and judge-detail fields needed to audit how an open-ended reward was produced.
inclusion_reason: The release exposes reusable preference, reward, or feedback records for training or evaluating reasoning systems.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open-ended responses are often close in overall quality. With only coarse rubrics such as correctness and clarity, judges assign similar scores and miss local defects; missing weights and detailed criteria also cause different judges to interpret the same standard differently.

RubricHub first generates high-level principles, aggregates multiple models to add fine-grained criteria, weights, and scoring details, and uses difficulty evolution to construct responses that are harder to distinguish.

开放式回答常在总体质量上接近，只有“正确性、清晰度”等粗 rubric 时，评审模型会给出相似分数，难以识别局部缺陷；缺少权重和细则还会让不同 judge 对同一标准产生不同解释。

RubricHub 先生成高层原则，再聚合多模型补充细粒度 criteria、权重和评分细节，并用 difficulty evolution 构造更难区分的回答。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is RubricHub_v1, containing about 110K cross-domain rubric and scoring records. Its central data object is prompts, criteria, weights, candidate responses, criterion scores, and review details. The construction mechanism is combining principle-guided coarse criteria, multi-model refinement, and difficulty evolution, which converts coarse or unstable feedback into structured records for training or evaluation.

论文的核心贡献是开放RubricHub_v1，规模为约11万条跨域rubric与评分记录，核心数据对象为prompt、criterion、权重、候选回答、分项评分与评审细节。其高层机制是：原则引导生成粗维度，多模型聚合细则，并用difficulty evolution增强区分度，从而把原本粗粒度、昂贵或不稳定的反馈转换为可训练、可评测的结构化记录。该数据主要用于HealthBench及开放式任务，并通过RuFT拒绝采样微调后进行RuRL验证效用。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Prepare sources: Use domain principles to create a coarse set of quality dimensions for each prompt.
  2. Generate records: Ask several models to propose observable subcriteria, weights, and scoring anchors, then aggregate and deduplicate them.
  3. Verify and filter: Generate harder candidate responses through difficulty evolution and retain rubric–score records that remain discriminative.
  4. Organize and use: Organize about 110K records as RubricHub_v1; RuFT and RuRL are used only to validate downstream utility.

1. 准备来源：收集与任务匹配的问题、候选回答或推理轨迹，并保留标准答案、偏好标签、工具结果或原始来源。
  2. 生成数据：围绕prompt、criterion、权重、候选回答、分项评分与评审细节执行核心构建流程，即原则引导生成粗维度，多模型聚合细则，并用difficulty evolution增强区分度。
  3. 验证筛选：利用原始标签、规则验证器、外部工具、人工审查或多信号一致性判断样本是否保留。
  4. 整理使用：形成约11万条跨域rubric与评分记录，发布为RubricHub_v1；随后通过RuFT拒绝采样微调后进行RuRL验证数据对HealthBench及开放式任务的价值。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The core experiments evaluate the method on open-ended reward modeling and post-training. the RuFT plus RuRL model reaches 69.3 on HealthBench. The results support supervision from combining principle-guided coarse criteria, multi-model refinement, and difficulty evolution under the reported setup, but remain limited by the base model, data, and inference budget. The conclusion is limited to the tested open-ended tasks, training setup, domain coverage, and model scale.
核心实验在HealthBench及开放式任务中检验该方法。Qwen3-14B经RuFT+RuRL后在HealthBench达到69.3。结果支持原则引导生成粗维度，多模型聚合细则，并用difficulty evolution增强区分度产生的监督在当前设置下有效，但结论仍受基础模型、数据和推理预算限制。 结论限于所测开放任务、训练配置、领域覆盖及模型规模。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior methods rely on final answers, generic step labels, or a single LLM judge, leaving a mismatch between feedback and the target. This work centers supervision on prompts, criteria, weights, candidate responses, criterion scores, and review details, uses combining principle-guided coarse criteria, multi-model refinement, and difficulty evolution to generate and filter records, and releases RubricHub_v1. The novelty lies in the data object and acceptance rule rather than standard training algorithms.
已有方法多依赖最终答案、通用步骤标签或单一 judge，反馈粒度与目标不匹配。本文以prompt、criterion、权重、候选回答、分项评分与评审细节为对象，通过原则引导生成粗维度，多模型聚合细则，并用difficulty evolution增强区分度生成和筛选监督，并整理为RubricHub_v1。新意在数据对象与接受规则，而非常规训练算法。

title: Limitations
局限
html: First, the main risks are shared model bias, missing expert standards, and confounding between data and training recipe; changing the model, domain, budget, or verifier may shift the labels, so reuse requires sampled human audits and agreement reporting. Second, automatic generation or rule-based verification usually covers observable outcomes and cannot guarantee that intermediate explanations are faithful, complete, and free of gaming. Third, source data may overlap with public benchmarks when deduplication and contamination procedures are incomplete.
第一，多模型共享偏差、专家标准缺失与训练配方混杂，这可能使标签在更换模型、领域、预算或验证器后发生漂移；复用前应抽样人工审计并报告一致性。第二，自动生成或规则验证通常只能覆盖可观察结果，不能保证中间理由忠实、完整且无投机。第三，数据来源和评测任务可能与公开基准重合，若去重与污染信息未充分披露，应按问题和轨迹两级检查。不能把高分直接解释为通用过程正确性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a system targeting open-ended reward modeling and post-training, RubricHub_v1 can train or evaluate the corresponding reward model, verifier, critic, or ranker. A controlled reuse should keep the base model fixed and compare accuracy, error localization, calibration, search efficiency, or final policy performance with and without the data. The construction procedure can also be transferred to a new domain when reliable source tasks and verification signals are available.
如果你要构建HealthBench及开放式任务系统，可直接复用RubricHub_v1训练相应的奖励模型、验证器、critic或排序器，并以固定基础模型比较使用与不使用该数据时的准确率、错误定位、校准度、搜索效率或最终策略表现。也可复用其构建流程，为新领域生成同结构记录。输入必须包含可靠的题目来源及对应验证信号；当任务缺少可信标签、工具或人工审查，或错误成本很高时，不应直接沿用原接受规则。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence positioning: Coarse rubrics cannot distinguish open-ended responses with similar surface quality; it uses combining principle-guided coarse criteria, multi-model refinement, and difficulty evolution.
  2. Method handle: The pipeline covers source preparation, record generation, verification, filtering, and release.
  3. Data handle: RubricHub_v1 contains about 110K cross-domain rubric and scoring records and centers on prompts, criteria, weights, candidate responses, criterion scores, and review details.
  4. Evidence anchor: The ruft plus rurl model reaches 69.3 on healthbench, with conclusions limited to the reported setup.
  5. Reuse decision: It is most suitable for open-ended reward modeling and post-training; shared model bias, missing expert standards, and confounding between data and training recipe must be checked before reuse.

1. 一句话定位：论文针对“粗粒度rubric难区分质量接近的开放式回答”，用原则引导生成粗维度，多模型聚合细则，并用difficulty evolution增强区分度生成过程反馈。
  2. 方法抓手： 流程为来源整理、数据生成、验证筛选和发布。
  3. 数据抓手：RubricHub_v1包含约11万条跨域rubric与评分记录，核心记录为prompt、criterion、权重、候选回答、分项评分与评审细节。
  4. 证据锚点：Qwen3-14B经RuFT+RuRL后在HealthBench达到69.3，结论限于论文设置。
  5. 复用决定：适合HealthBench及开放式任务；复用前必须检查多模型共享偏差、专家标准缺失与训练配方混杂。
